_comment: GitHub Copilot Cloud Agent Firewall — configures the built-in sandbox firewall for the Copilot coding agent (cloud agent running in GitHub Actions). Manage org-wide at: Enterprise/Organization → AI Controls → Coding agent → Firewall. Per-repository: Settings → Copilot → Coding agent → Firewall.
_availability: GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Business plans. Organization-level firewall policy GA April 3, 2026.

_recommended_allowlist_covers: Language package registries (npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Go modules, Cargo)
_security_notes: Set allow_repository_admin_override to false to prevent per-repo admins from weakening the org-wide firewall policy.
The recommended allowlist covers standard package registries but NOT arbitrary internet access.
Add corporate artifact registries (Artifactory, Nexus, CodeArtifact) to custom_allowlist if needed.
The firewall is active inside the GitHub Actions runner sandbox — it does not affect IDE-based agent features.
Review custom_allowlist additions with the same rigor as firewall rule changes — each entry is a potential exfiltration path.

security_validation._comment: Automatic security checks the coding agent runs before finalizing any PR. Configure at: repository Settings → Copilot → Coding agent. No GHAS license required.
security_validation._note: As of June 9, 2026, these validations also apply to code generated by third-party coding agents (Claude, Codex) connected to GitHub — no additional config needed.

branch_protections._comment: Agent-generated PRs are subject to all branch protection rules. CI/CD workflows require human approval before running on agent PRs — this is an enforced protection against supply chain attacks.
